query:
select current_database() as database_name,
 current_user as role_name,
 current_setting('server_version') as postgres_version,
 has_schema_privilege('authenticated','private','USAGE') as authenticated_private_usage,
 has_schema_privilege('anon','private','USAGE') as anon_private_usage,
 has_schema_privilege('service_role','private','USAGE') as service_role_private_usage,
 to_regclass('private.recent_changes')::text as recent_changes,
 to_regclass('private.recent_change_versions')::text as recent_change_versions,
 to_regprocedure('public.list_recent_changes(uuid,uuid,bigint,integer)')::text as list_rpc,
 to_regprocedure('public.undo_recent_change(uuid,uuid,uuid)')::text as undo_rpc,
 (select count(*) from pg_catalog.pg_trigger t join pg_catalog.pg_class c on c.oid=t.tgrelid join pg_catalog.pg_namespace n on n.oid=c.relnamespace where not t.tgisinternal and t.tgname='recent_changes_capture' and n.nspname='public') as journal_trigger_count;
